title: Payable Closing Costs on the Loan Estimate for the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit
content:
For a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit measured against the latest Loan Estimate, which closing costs are payable depends on program and pricing, as recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File and its latest Loan Estimate.

**Clause.** On an FHA or VA file not flagged as a higher-priced mortgage loan they are the zero-tolerance total plus the 10 percent tolerance total on the Loan Estimate; on any file flagged as a higher-priced mortgage loan they are the zero-tolerance total alone; on any other file they are the nonrecurring closing costs.

| Loan program | Flagged as a higher-priced mortgage loan | Payable closing costs on the Loan Estimate |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed or Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | no | zero-tolerance total plus 10 percent tolerance total |
| any program, FHA and VA included | yes | zero-tolerance total alone |
| any other program | no | nonrecurring closing costs |

The higher-priced flag is read first: a flagged FHA or VA file takes the zero-tolerance total alone.

### Worked example (hypothetical Loan Estimate)

Latest Loan Estimate: nonrecurring closing costs 6800.00, zero-tolerance total 3100.00, 10 percent tolerance total 1900.00.

| File | Payable closing costs |
|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, not flagged | 5000.00 |
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, flagged | 3100.00 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed, not flagged | 6800.00 |
